$description: Non-token configuration of the semantic typography layer (the tokens are typography.today.tokens.json and typography.next.tokens.json). output / typesOutput: the generated CSS and the TypeScript union of the style names. modes: one value set per mode, Today first (the default rendering) and the preview modes on their own attribute. todayInherits: composite properties Today does not set (the variable is left undeclared, so the declaration falls back to inheritance); todayDefaults: the values the Today tokens must state for them. modifiers: utilities applied on top of a role; `token` modifiers read type.modifier.<name> of each mode, the others carry per-mode CSS values because DTCG has no type for them (font-variant-numeric).

next.description: Next typography preview: the plain role bundles in Sora / Inter Display; exceptions follow their role.
